data.name: Brander
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘brandan’, meaning ‘to burn’. This name was borne by a 6th-century Anglo-Saxon saint, Bran, who was revered for his courage and strength. In Christian tradition, Brander represents the indomitable spirit and unwavering faith that inspires others to follow in the face of adversity.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner flame of spiritual passion and resilience.

in_hebrew.name: ברנדר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מקור השם 'ברנדר' בעברית, המציין 'בן שבעים', או 'בן 70'. השם 'ברנדר' ידוע מן המקרא, כמופיע בכתובים הקדומים, כאשר הוא נושא 'ברנדר' (בן 70) בפסיפס היהודי. השם 'ברנדר' משמש גם במסורות היהודיות כמונים ל - 'בן 70' כמספר שילוש. בקרב היהודים, נהוג 'ברנדר' כצורה בציון 'בן 70' ו'בן שבעים' בעת שיבתא, ובחג 'השבועות'.

in_greek.name: Βρανδέρ
in_greek.long_meaning: ο όνομα 'Βρανδέρ' προέρχεται από τον αρχαίο ελληνικό τύπο 'Βρανδέρ', που σημαίνει 'άνθος του τούριου', μια φράση που χρησιμοποιήθηκε για να περιγράψει το σπάνιτο άνθος του τούριου. Η λέξη 'Βρανδέρ' χρησιμοποιείται σε μερικές περιπτώσεις για να περιγράψει το άτομο που έρχεται από την εθνοτική ομάδα των Βρανδέρ. Στη Νέα Διαθήκη, δεν υπάρχει ο όρος 'Βρανδέρ'.

in_latin.name: Brander
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen 'Brander' derivatur ex radicibus 'brand' significans 'vir bonus, fortis et fidus', nomen quod est in usu antiquo. In Ecclesia Christiana, nomen 'Brander' significat hominem fortem et fidum, qui est bonus et amicus. In usu antiquo, nomen 'Brander' significat animum qui est fortis et fidus, qui est bonus et amicus.

in_english.name: Brander
in_english.meaning: strong and loyal man, a good friend
in_english.long_meaning: The name Brander originates from the Old English word 'brand', meaning 'fire' or 'sword', and the Old Norse word 'r', meaning 'man'. In Christian tradition, Brander is a strong and loyal man, a good friend, and a defender of faith. In modern times, Brander is used as a given name, symbolizing strength, loyalty, and faithfulness. As a surname, Brander indicates a person of strength and courage, who is a good friend and a loyal companion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Brander has historical roots in Anglo-Saxon England and carries the legacy of a brave warrior saint. Its Old English origin, meaning ‘to burn’, adds a sense of intensity and passion to the name. In the Middle Ages, naming a child Brander conveyed a powerful message of courage and resilience. Today, this name still holds a strong cultural significance, often relating to bravery, protection, and honor.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Brander is rooted in the powerful connection between the individual and their faith. Brander represents the indomitable spirit that refuses to back down in the face of trials and challenges. This name encapsulates the idea of standing firm in one's beliefs, even during difficult times. It serves as a reminder that, like St. Bran, we have the strength and courage to overcome the obstacles before us and maintain our unwavering faith in God.
